name: Ocean of EPUB
description: Ocean of EPUB — light novel, manga and web novel index. Search and browsing verified working against the live site; results are links and covers, not downloadable files.
readableNote: Search, browsing and covers work, and the selectors below were verified with cheerio against live pages (2026-10-05): 'article.post' matches 6 result cards on /?s=hidden+love and yields title, href and the Jetpack CDN cover. NOT readable, and deliberately so — the site exposes no retrievable file. Three detail pages were fetched and none contained a file link. Where a book lists a download it is a charexempire.com/{code} shortlink, which 302s to kecapku.com/safe.php and then bounces to Google's redirect for that parked domain: a 0-byte HTML page, not an EPUB. One sampled book had no download link at all. So results open as links and covers; there is nothing to hand to the reader. Version 2 corrects the endpoint shape: v1 nested its rules under endpoints.json using invented key names (list/url_/type) that the client never reads, and set api:'json', which hard-codes JSON.parse on an HTML page. Rules now sit at endpoints.search / endpoints.popular in the real ListingRule form (selector/title/url/thumb) with no api flag. Flip readable to true only if the upstream file host starts serving real files.
